_about: Synthetic fixtures for doclines format tests. The cheap-eyes 0.2 set (generated 2026-10-02) is kept as is, minus refused.xls/.xlsx/.odt (those formats are supported now). New files generated 2026-10-07 by Claude (chat): LibreOffice 24.2 via UNO from source.html and from a generated spreadsheet/deck (text.odt/docm/dotx, text.xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xls/ods, big-sst.xls, text.pptx/potx/ppt/odp, refused-encrypted.* with password 'test'), python-pptx (deck source), openpyxl (text-1904.xlsx), pandoc 3 from book.md (text.epub, text-epub2.epub, text.fb2, notes.odt), by hand (EML, FB2 cp1251, fb2.zip, EPUB encryption.xml variants, refused-stub.* detection-only stubs, refused-damaged.docx = first half of text.docm, refused-excel95-stub.xls = text.xls with its Workbook stream renamed Book). msg-*.msg: copies of Apache-2.0 test files from HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader; refused-encrypted.ppt: copy of an Apache-2.0 test file from Apache POI (2026-10-07; LibreOffice does not save encrypted PPT); see NOTICE. Assert properties, not byte-equal text. The password value is a fake built for masking tests. Refused entries: `code` is the DoclinesError code; `reason`, kept on the cheap-eyes 0.2 entries only, is a substring of the 0.2 reason.
